subject: AP BIOLOGY
caption: Mitosis or meiosis? One mnemonic and one question end the mix-up: mitosis is PMAT and makes 2 identical cells, meiosis divides twice and makes 4 different ones. Save this for your next bio quiz. Free AP Biology study guide with quizzes and flashcards at precisstudy.com/ap-biology (no sign-up).

slides.title: MITOSIS OR MEIOSIS? STOP MIXING THEM UP.
MITOSIS = PMAT
lines: Metaphase · line up in the middle
slides.note: One division. Ends with 2 identical cells.

slides.title: MEIOSIS = TWO ROUNDS
slides.note: Two divisions. Ends with 4 different cells, each with half the chromosomes.

slides.title: EXAMPLE 1
slides.problem: A skin cell divides to heal a cut.
steps: Body cells copying themselves means growth and repair.

slides.title: EXAMPLE 2
slides.problem: A cell is making sperm or egg cells.
steps: Sex cells need half the chromosomes.

slides.title: WATCH OUT
points: Crossing over and random pairing make every meiosis cell genetically different.
Mitosis divides once. Meiosis divides twice.

pageTitle: Mitosis vs Meiosis: PMAT, Key Differences and Examples
description: Mitosis or meiosis? Learn PMAT, count the divisions and daughter cells, and sort two examples, plus the mistake that costs points.
